h: France's Macron reportedly postpones state visit to Nigeria
p: French President Emmanuel Macron has reportedly delayed the state visit to Nigeria planned for 28 October. The delay is said to be linked to protests and unrest back home in France. No new date has been announced.
more: The trip had been billed as a chance to review progress between Abuja and Paris.
A fresh date is yet to be confirmed by either government.
